articles.headline: Man United at risk of going bottom of Premier League after 4-0 Brentford loss
articles.description: Manchester United could slip to bottom of the Premier League after a harrowing 4-0 defeat to Brentford at Old Trafford.

articles.headline: Mauricio Pochettino warns Man United that 'history' won't prevent relegation
articles.description: Mauricio Pochettino has warned Manchester United that the club is not too big to go down by insisting "you cannot win only with the badge and with the history."

articles.headline: Pochettino admits Man United's confidence is low after 'painful' defeat vs. Brentford
articles.description: Manchester United head coach Mauricio Pochettino reacts to their 4-0 home defeat to Brentford in the Premier League.

articles.headline: Youri Tielemans denies Man United mentality problem after heavy Brentford loss
articles.description: Youri Tielemans has denied that there is a mentality problem in the dressing room after Manchester United slumped to another 4-0 defeat at home to Brentford on Saturday.

articles.headline: Manchester United have the worst defense in Europe's top five leagues
articles.description: After 18 matches this season in all competitions, Manchester United have conceded 40 goals. No other team in Europe's top five leagues can match that.

articles.headline: 'Keep our home, not our owners' - Man United fans protest during Brentford loss
articles.description: Manchester United fans continued to express anger at the ownership and plans to demolish Old Trafford as team lose to Brentford.

articles.headline: Hislop: Man United don't have the grit for a relegation fight
articles.description: Shaka Hislop discusses Manchester United's performance after their 4-0 loss to Brentford.

articles.headline: Brentford pummel Manchester United to hand Mauricio Pochettino nightmare Old Trafford debut
articles.description: Mauricio Pochettino's painful start to life at the Manchester United helm continued as Brentford romped to their first Old Trafford victory since 1937.

articles.headline: Man United's dreadful defence breaks unwanted Premier League record
articles.description: Manchester United have become the first side in history to concede two or more goals in seven successive halves of Premier League football.

articles.headline: Premier League recap: Brentford rout United in Pochettino's home debut
articles.description: Brentford earned their first win at Old Trafford since 1937 as Manchester United's Premier League winless run stretched to 10 games.

articles.headline: Bruno Fernandes overcomes illness to start for Man United vs. Brentford
articles.description: Bruno Fernandes will start for Manchester United against Brentford on Saturday despite illness threatening his involvement.

articles.headline: Transfer rumors, news: Manchester United's Bruno Fernandes still eyeing way out
articles.description: Manchester United captain Bruno Fernandes is still considering his options despite his contract extension. Transfer Talk has the latest.

articles.headline: Pochettino defends his Man United management style: 'I'm not nice'
articles.description: Manchester United head coach Mauricio Pochettino has hit back at criticism of his management style by insisting: "I am not nice."

articles.headline: Bruno Fernandes contract extended by Man United until 2028 - sources
articles.description: Manchester United have triggered an extension in Bruno Fernandes' contract, sources have told ESPN, but the midfielder remains a doubt for Brentford's visit to Old Trafford on Saturday.

articles.headline: Would any USMNT players really make Man United better if they followed Poch?
articles.description: Now that USMNT manager Mauricio Pochettino has taken over Man United, would it make sense for USMNT players to join their ex-coach?

articles.headline: Hislop: Next games a 'barometer' in Man United relegation battle
articles.description: Shaka Hislop and Steve Nicol question whether Manchester United are at risk of relegation from the Premier League.

articles.headline: Xabi Alonso: Wesley Fofana interview row 'closed' after apology
articles.description: Xabi Alonso called the matter "closed" after Wesley Fofana appeared to joke about Chelsea's Carabao Cup exit to Liverpool during an unauthorised interview.

articles.headline: FA panel details 'obvious error' in Leny Yoro red card against Liverpool
articles.description: Referee Sam Barrott made an "obvious error" in sending off Manchester United defender Leny Yoro against Liverpool, an independent regulatory commission unanimously concluded.

articles.headline: Fernandes 'not closing door' on Sporting return amid United contract uncertainty
articles.description: Bruno Fernandes has said he is not ruling out a return to Sporting CP, the club he left to join Man United in 2020.

articles.headline: Joshua Zirkzee backs Senne Lammens: 'We didn't draw because of him'
articles.description: Joshua Zirkzee has said the Manchester United dressing room will rally around Senne Lammens after the goalkeeper's error against Sporting CP denied Mauricio Pochettino a first win as head coach.
